mempool: address-indexed query + batch reads (issue #15 Tier 1)
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/17

## Issue #15 Tier 1 — wallet mempool visibility (pull half)

Implements the **Tier 1** ("pull") half of #15, as the bundled single PR you OK'd in Q1. A receiver can now see unconfirmed funds, and multi-address wallets stop thrashing the scan limiter — no transport change.

Your three corrections are folded in:

- **A — three insertion paths, not two.** The `by_script` index is threaded through all three `add_validated` sites: RPC `send_raw_transaction`, P2P `NewTx`, **and the reorg orphan-reintroduction path** (`sync.rs`). The reorg path is in the test matrix from day 1 (confirm-clears + reorg-reintroduction-repopulates), so a reorg can't silently drop index rows.
- **B — `MempoolEntry` shape grows.** Each entry now retains its resolved spent inputs (`script` + `value` per spent UTXO), captured at admission from the validation snapshot (already in hand at every call site) and consumed at removal — so the spend-side rows de-index without re-resolving against a since-changed UTXO set. Bounded by the 8192-tx cap (sub-MB).
- **C — SSE scaling** is Tier 2, not in this PR.

Q2 answered: `get_address_mempool` returns **full per-tx detail** (txid + received outputs + spent outpoints + amounts).

### What's here

- **Mempool `by_script` index** — `script` (32-byte address) → `{tx_ids}` touching it, on both incoming (output) and outgoing (resolved spent-input) sides. Mirrors the confirmed-set `UtxoSet::by_script` lifecycle; maintained on every removal path (`remove` / `evict_lowest`, transitively `remove_confirmed` / `revalidate`).
- **`get_address_mempool(address)`** — full unconfirmed-tx detail for an address. Scan-rate-limited (30/min budget) but **not** held under `utxo_scan_sem`, since it only touches the mempool lock, not the UTXO read lock the semaphore guards.
- **Batch `get_balances` / `get_address_utxos_batch`** — up to 100 addresses per call, one rate slot + one UTXO read lock + one tip read for the whole batch. This is the limiter-thrash fix. Existing single-address methods untouched.

### Tests

- Unit (mempool, no `testnet` feature needed): index/de-index lifecycle on both sides, empty-set pruning, `evict_lowest` de-index, two-tx-same-address coexistence, `address_mempool` amount reporting.
- Reorg matrix (Correction A): `remove_confirmed` clears the rows; re-admitting via `add_validated` (the reorg reintroduction path) re-populates them.

`cargo test --lib` green (228 + 7 new). Note `tests/audit_fix_tests_7.rs` and `tests/eviction_integration.rs` fail to compile on `main` already (stale `Node`/`LogicalPeer` struct literals, unrelated to this change) — verified against a pristine `origin/main`; ran the lib suite individually.

### Deferred (separate PRs, per the landing order)

- **Tier 2** — SSE push + Electrum-style nudge bus (blocked on the Correction-C routing-vs-broadcast decision).
- **Pagination** — the 1000-UTXO silent truncation at `rpc.rs` (a correctness bug, standalone).
- **`get_address_history`** — until there's explicit demand.
